## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] I added or updated tests, including a browser test if this touches `postMessage` or the player UI
- [ ] I updated the README if people can use or see this change
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
- [ ] Anything from another page is still validated, and a new command that changes the player is off by default
- [ ] The commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat(ui): ...`)
- [ ] I did not bump the version
